verdict.rationale: The pack documents Runway 'Characters' with Avatars, custom voices and an embedded widget. Those are real-time conversational sessions, a related but different feature, not a script-to-video presenter workflow. Generic text-to-video and voice cloning are also documented, but nothing shows pasting a script and rendering a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio
